_comment: Supported-Mac list for the macOS-under-aura-HV installer. This is a conservative
draft: a Mac/SoC/build is listed only when there is a path to qualify it. The
'self_boot' status says whether 'pick the macOS volume and it boots under the HV
on its own, no host' has actually been proven on that SoC yet. As of this writing
that has NOT been proven on any SoC (see docs/macos-hv-install.md); the installer
refuses an unqualified SoC unless run with --allow-unqualified, which only stages
files and does the enrol without claiming the self-boot works.
Fields marked 'confirm-on-hardware' are the hardware-free best effort; the J616s
acceptance run (ESPBOOT-3) confirms or corrects them.

T6041.exclaves_note: the j616sap BuildIdentity carries no Ap,ExclaveOS/Ap,cL4: guest is SPTM+TXM+XNU only (confirm-on-hardware)
T6041.stage2_build_flags: CHAINLOADING=1 ESP_STAGE2=1 SPTM_VIRT=1 SPTM_VIRT_GUARDED=1 SPTM_VIRT_ESP=1 AURACTL=1
T6041.self_boot_note: first SoC targeted for on-device self-boot (ESPBOOT-3 acceptance)

T6050.self_boot_note: files load from the ESP but the validated entry is still a host chainload of stage2-macos.bin; its Stage 1 ignored aura-try (docs/m5-macos-esp.md). No unattended self-boot yet.

T8140.self_boot_note: entry is a one-shot bless of the macOS volume -> aura proxy -> host chainload. No unattended self-boot yet.
